target_rule: E_star must be the verified evolutionary successor of B0 implemented through an exact, reviewable transformation of the Andrianna repository. A disconnected greenfield system, adjacent replacement, facade, wrapper-only substitute, second authority or duplicate subsystem cannot satisfy FOC-19/T7.
preservation_rule: Every reachable B0 capability, invariant, trace, public protocol, durable state meaning, recovery property, deployment path and verification gate is preserved or migrated to a strictly stronger verified form. Any unexplained or regressed B0 surface blocks.

phase_order.phase_2: The blind producer cannot inspect B0. It must emit PHASE-2-IMPLEMENTATION-ABSTRACTION-MAP.json, mapping every proposed architecture mechanism to abstract implementation responsibilities, interfaces, state, dependencies, invariants, migration assumptions and verification needs.
phase_order.post_phase_2_reveal: After the Phase-2 submission hash is fixed and the candidate passes independent review, reveal B0 and complete an exhaustive semantic repository census before planning a change.
phase_order.before_repository_write: Produce, hash and independently review the complete crosswalk, changeset plan, capability-preservation matrix, migration DAG and verification matrix. Repository mutation remains unauthorized until creator approval of that immutable plan.
phase_order.implementation: Apply the approved changes in a dedicated branch/worktree of the Andrianna repository, as verified vertical increments of the final architecture. No study ZIP or supervisory report is committed to the repository.
phase_order.final: The exact built executable, source tree, change manifest and proof objects instantiate E_star; T7 and all preceding obligations are replayed against the resulting commit.

required_surfaces: ASDF systems, components and load order
durable stores, schemas, migrations and recovery paths
tests, proof gates, fixtures and toolchain assumptions
existing capabilities, invariants and theorem debts
repository_census_closure.closure_rule: Every in-scope tracked path, definition, authority, writer, store, command, capability and verification gate has exactly one stable census identity and disposition. One unexplained surface blocks FOC-19.
repository_census_closure.unknown_rule: UNKNOWN never authorizes a repository change or a preservation claim.

change_semantics.ADD: Adds a final-architecture capability with explicit authority, consumers, invariants and verification; no orphan or speculative subsystem.
change_semantics.MODIFY: Changes an existing semantic authority in place with complete caller/consumer impact and preservation evidence.
change_semantics.REFACTOR: Preserves declared observable semantics while improving internal structure; requires differential or bisimulation-style evidence over the complete affected surface.
change_semantics.MOVE: Moves ownership without creating dual authority, split state or compatibility ambiguity.
change_semantics.REPLACE: Supersedes an existing mechanism only after the replacement proves universal capability/trace refinement and migration closure.
change_semantics.REMOVE: Permitted only with exhaustive caller/consumer/store/deployment evidence proving redundancy, completed migration or stronger replacement.

crosswalk_totality: Every Phase-2 architecture mechanism maps to one or more exact B0 repository changes or receives a proof that B0 already implements a strictly sufficient form. Every planned repository change maps back to a frozen architecture, preservation, commercial-axis or proof obligation. Orphans in either direction block.
migration_rule: The migration DAG is acyclic, dependency-complete and composed of verified vertical increments that always belong to the final architecture. Each increment declares pre-state, post-state, preserved properties, recovery behavior and evidence. A deliberately inferior interim architecture is forbidden.
formal_rule: There exists a finite approved change sequence Delta_B0 such that Apply(B0,Delta_B0)=E_star; every intermediate approved increment preserves all still-binding B0 invariants and capabilities; the final source, build and executable instantiate the proved A_star/E_star; and the crosswalk/manifest is total and exact.
